description: ECHO: Search EPA-regulated facilities by location, county, facility name, NAICS industry code, environmental program, or compliance status across CAA, CWA, RCRA, TRI, and SDWA. Returns facility name, EPA Registry ID, coordinates, county FIPS code, per-program registration flags, TRI facility IDs, five-year inspection and penalty totals, and TRI release totals. Registry IDs returned here feed epa_echo_get_facility; TRI facility IDs feed epa_tri_get_facility_releases. Supports proximity search via latitude + longitude + radius_miles. At least one geographic filter (zip_code, state, city, county_fips, or a complete latitude+longitude+radius_miles triple) is required — unscoped searches time out. Page past limit with offset and nextOffset.

active_only.description: When true, return only facilities with an active permit

city.description: City name, case-insensitive; matches cities that begin with it ("TACOMA", or "SEAT" for SEATTLE and SEATAC). Pair with state.

county.description: County name, case-insensitive. A trailing County, Parish, Borough, City and Borough, Census Area, or Municipality is dropped ("King County" searches KING), then it matches recorded county names that begin with it, so KING in VA also matches KING GEORGE. Requires state. Covers every registration ECHO places in the county, including ones with no program record that county_fips leaves out.

county_fips.description: 5-digit county FIPS code, state + county (e.g. "53033" for King County, WA); matches it exactly and scopes a search on its own. Leaves out registrations with no program record, which county includes.

facility_name.description: Facility name words, case-insensitive: every word must appear as a whole word, in any order, in a name ECHO records for the facility, so "BOEING" matches BOEING PLANT 2 and "OEING" matches nothing. A match can come from another name ECHO records for the facility, so a returned name can lack the words. No commas. Pair with a geographic filter.

has_violation.description: When true, return only facilities with at least one program in significant noncompliance (complianceStatus "Significant Violation")

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Pair with longitude and radius_miles for proximity search.

limit.description: Maximum number of facilities to return in one call (1–100, default 50). A larger value, up to 5,000, returns 100 with a notice. Page past it with offset and nextOffset.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Pair with latitude and radius_miles for proximity search.

naics.description: NAICS industry code, 2–6 digits; fewer than six match every code that begins with them ("3364" for aerospace product and parts manufacturing). Pair with a geographic filter.

offset.description: Number of facilities to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's nextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

programs.description: Restrict results to facilities registered in one environmental program — ECHO filters on a single program per search, so pass one value. CAA=air, CWA=water, RCRA=hazardous waste, TRI=toxic releases, SDWA=drinking water.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around the given latitude/longitude (max 100). Requires latitude and longitude.

state.description: 2-letter state or territory code (e.g. "WA", "PR"), case-insensitive. Required with county. ECHO also files facilities under codes outside the USPS set, such as DM for offshore Gulf of Mexico platforms; any 2-character code is searched as written.

zip_code.description: 5-digit ZIP code to search within; a ZIP+4 such as "98108-1234" searches its first five digits

name: epa_echo_search_facilities

effectiveQuery.description: The search as the server sent it upstream, in this tool's input names: normalized values, how each text filter matched ("=" exact, "contains", "begins with", "has words"), and defaults that change what comes back. Terms are separated by "; ".

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_geographic_filter`: No geographic filter (zip_code, state, city, county_fips, or a latitude+longitude+radius_miles triple) was provided. `incomplete_proximity`: A proximity search was started but latitude, longitude, and radius_miles were not all provided. `county_requires_state`: county was provided without state. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facilities.description: One page of matching EPA facilities, in ECHO's order: limit facilities from offset

items.description: EPA facility record with Registry ID, location, program flags, and compliance summary

complianceStatus.description: Overall compliance status text from ECHO

fipsCode.description: 5-digit county FIPS code — use with Census API for demographics

inspectionCount.description: Inspections over the last five years, across programs

programs.description: Program registration flags — the same programs the programs filter selects

air.description: Has a Clean Air Act (CAA) stationary-source record in ICIS-Air

rcra.description: Has an RCRA hazardous waste handler record

sdwa.description: Has a Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) public water system record

tri.description: Has a Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) facility ID (triFacilityIds is non-empty), whether or not it reported in the latest year

water.description: Has a Clean Water Act (CWA) discharge permit record in ICIS-NPDES

registryId.description: EPA FRS Registry ID — use as input to epa_echo_get_facility

totalPenaltiesInDollars.description: Penalties from formal enforcement actions over the last five years, across programs, in dollars

triFacilityIds.description: 15-character TRI facility IDs ECHO records for this facility, in ECHO's order, which is not reporting-year order — pass one as facility_id to epa_tri_get_facility_releases for per-chemical releases. A site can carry several from successive operators. Empty when the facility has no TRI facility ID.

triReleasesTransfersInLbs.description: Total TRI on/off-site releases and transfers in pounds for ECHO's latest TRI year (summary). For the per-chemical breakdown, pass one of triFacilityIds to epa_tri_get_facility_releases — the Registry ID is not a TRI facility ID.

limitNotice.description: Present when limit was above the cap and the call returned the cap instead.

message.description: Recovery hint when the page is empty: no facility matched, or offset is past the last match. Absent when facilities are returned.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page: present exactly when more records follow, absent on the last page. Pass it as offset to continue.

notice.description: Present when more facilities follow: names the offset that continues the list.

totalCount.description: Facilities matched before limit and offset were applied

title: Search EPA Facilities
